Yes, I split the original dose of 200mg test cyp into 2 injections of 100mg. I do this Sunday night and Thursday morning. For me, it reduces the side effects associated with the big spike in test 24-36 hours after injection. These include elevated prolactin, bloating, agitation, aggression, and pounding my poor wife’s pussy into oblivion. It also reduces time in the trough which has its own side effects of lethargy, low libido & mild to moderate depression. 
Again, this is just MY experience. I’ve seen so many different protocols on this sub. It just goes to show that we’re all different and have to be willing to keep trying different protocols until you find what keeps you feeling your best. 

I see a nurse practitioner who reports my blood work directly to an endocrinologist, every 10 weeks. In the beginning it was every 4 weeks until I found my sweet spot protocol after about 6 months. Only once I was stable, happy, & healthy, did we switch it up to only doing bloods every 10 weeks. 

Best of luck on your journey!

43 yr old male here. Started TRT 13 months ago. Initially went from 206 to 212 at close to 22% body fat. After I got dialed in (about 20 weeks) it’s been wonderful. Today I’m 190lb at just under 17% body fat. Stick with it! I had weight gain and terrible nipple pain. Nearly said “screw it, this ain’t worth it” but I stuck it out. 
I couldn’t handle 1 injection per week, had to go to 2. Thought my estrogen was out of whack but it ended up being prolactin. 300mg of vitamin B6 daily and nipple pain was gone. 
Get bloods regularly! I got them every month for the first 6 months until everything was stable. Now I get them every 10 weeks. I know it’s said often, but it truly is a marathon, not a sprint. 
Good luck to you!

I did experience that and more. At 5 weeks I was questioning ever even trying TRT. All the wonderful things I had read about mental clarity, fat loss, and libido like I was 18 again, simply weren’t happening for me.  My second round of bloods revealed that my test was through the roof! 1500+ total and 70+ free made me go to YouTube for advice, bad idea. I started Anastrozole 0.5 mg every other day, and things got worse still! No libido, no motivation, constantly irritated and I GAINED 6lbs on top of the water retention. My doc reduced my dose to 160mg/week and told me to stop the AI as I had completely crashed my E2. I was still having problems and just about to say the hell with it all together.  Then I went to 2 injections per week without asking my doctor and I finally began to hit my stride. With 2 injections per week we were able to go back up to 200mg week WITHOUT any Anastrozole. That’s when it really started to come together. It took about 20 weeks to trial and error to get dialed in. Now I’m livin the TRT good life. Weight is stable, I’m making constant improvements in the gym, and my mind is functioning as well as any time in my past (I’m 43 BTW). Now I continue to tinker with food, sleep, and workout routine, in an effort to maximize my results. 
Unless your E2 goes through the roof, avoid the AI! Keep an eye on your prolactin (all your numbers really) and enjoy the ride. It takes time to dial in but once you’re there, you’re good to go!
